item.title: Bodhi Day
item.description:
Bodhi Day Tom Thompson

Source: TW

Author: Tom Thompson

Visit Tom Thompson ’s website - The Awakened Heart Centre for Conscious Living .

( for Iku Mayeda — Gassho! )

Japanese Buddhists celebrate December 8 th as Bodhi Day, the day young prince Siddhartha Gautama of the Shakya clan dropped all clinging and aversion, stopped seeking, transcended suffering, and awakened to his true nature and to the true nature of all being. The young prince then became known as the Buddha, or the awakened one. For 2,600 years his teachings have spread across this planet, providing tools and insights that enable human beings everywhere to transcend the cause of suffering and awaken to their true nature.
